payload.title: Method overview
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to recreate Figure 1 from a publication, providing an overview of the LERM analysis technique. It utilizes the Pyleoclim library to load necessary data and employs various visualization libraries to set up the figure's aesthetics. The notebook focuses on configuring font sizes for different elements of the figure to ensure clarity and presentation quality. The code suppresses warnings for presentation purposes, although this is not recommended as a best practice.
goals: Recreate Figure 1 from the original publication
Provide an overview of the LERM analysis technique

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook sets up the environment to recreate Figure 1, focusing on the LERM analysis technique. It configures font sizes for various figure elements and uses Pyleoclim to load the necessary data.
